title: 🛡️ New: Expiry Guard Reminders!
message: Version 3.1.0 helps you look after your cards. Add an expiry date to your licence, insurance or any ID, and the app will remind you before it runs out.
points: Add Expiry Date: Open any card in the Studio, go to Design, and tap Set Expiry Date under any page. Every page can have its own date.
Get Reminded in Time: Choose when you want a reminder, 30 days, 7 days or 1 day before. You can pick more than one.
Your Own Days: Tap Custom to add any number of days you like, for example 45 or 90 days before.
Reminder on the Day: You also get a reminder on the day the card expires.
Works When the App Is Closed: Reminders arrive at 10 AM even if the app is closed, and keep working after you restart your phone.
Open From the Reminder: Tap a reminder to open that card straight away. Locked cards still ask for your fingerprint or PIN first.
Expiry Labels: When a card is 30 days or less from expiring, it shows a small label like 12D LEFT on the home screen, in the Wallet and in the 3D View.
Easy Colours: The label turns red when only 7 days or less are left, or when the card has already expired.
Expiring Soon Filter: A new Expiring Soon tab on the home screen shows only the cards that need renewing soon.
Turn Reminders On or Off: Use the Remind Me switch any time. Your expiry date stays saved either way.
Notifications Help: If notifications are turned off for the app, you'll see a clear message with a quick button to turn them back on.
Safe in Backups: Expiry dates and reminder settings are saved in your vault backup and come back when you restore.
Fixes: The card name bar in the 3D View no longer gets cut off on small screens.

title: ✨ Your Cards, Now Faster and Fully 3D!
message: Version 3.0.0 is our biggest update yet. Your Wallet now opens cards in live 3D, finding any card takes just one tap, and every screen feels smoother.
points: Live 3D Wallet: Tap a card in your Wallet and it opens in full 3D. Drag it to turn it around, just like in the Studio.
Easy Buttons: Flip, Studio and Done now sit at the bottom of the screen when a card is open, right under your thumb.
Back Where You Were: Close a card and the Wallet takes you back to the same spot in your list.
New Grid View: See 3 cards in every row, grouped by letter, A, B, C and so on. Pick Stack, List or Grid from the view button.
Swipe Pages in Grid: Cards with more than one page let you swipe between pages right inside the grid.
Find Cards Faster: Tap a letter or number at the top of the Wallet to jump straight to that card. Only letters you actually use are shown.
Tag Filter in Wallet: Show only the cards with a tag you pick, like Government Documents.
Smoother 3D View: Changing cards with the side wheel is now smooth, snaps neatly onto each card, and a quick swipe skips several cards at once.
Quick Select Strip: Tap the arrow button to see all your cards as small previews. Scroll and tap one to open it instantly.
Quick Buttons: Play, Flip and Add New Card buttons are now one tap away in the 3D View.
Add From Anywhere: Create a new card straight from the Wallet or the 3D View.
Page Previews on Home: Cards with more than one page show small page previews. Tap a preview to see that page, then tap the card to open it.
Always the Front Side: Cards now open showing the front. If you left a card on its back, it turns over smoothly by itself.
Smooth Flip Everywhere: Flipping a card in the Studio, Wallet and 3D View is now one smooth turn, with no flicker.
Same Look Everywhere: The 3D View now has the same glowing background as the Studio.
Faster and Smoother: The Wallet and 3D View run much smoother, even with lots of cards.
Fixes: Long card names no longer break the top bar, cards don't change by mistake when you touch the bottom buttons, and menus open in the right place.

title: 🔐 Never Lose Your Cards Again!
message: Version 2.5.0 brings Secure Backup. Save all your cards in one locked file and bring them back anytime, even on a new phone.
points: Secure Backup: Save all your cards in one file, with every page, finish, tag and lock included.
Password Protected: Your backup is locked with your own password. Nobody can open it without the password, not even us.
Save or Share: Keep the backup on your phone, or send it to Drive, email, WhatsApp or any app you like.
Easy Restore: Changed your phone? Open the menu, tap Restore, pick your backup file and enter your password.
Nothing Gets Replaced: Restoring only adds cards. Your current cards always stay safe.
Backup Copies: If a card is already on your phone or has the same name, it is added as "Name (backup)", so you can compare and delete what you don't need.
Clear Progress: See exactly which card, page and side is being saved or restored, like "Card 5 of 12, Page 2, Back side".
Wrong Password Check: If the password is wrong, you are told right away and can try again.
Locked Cards Stay Safe: Cards with a lock ask for your fingerprint or PIN before backup, and stay locked after restore.
New Menu Button: Tap the menu button beside the search bar for Backup, Restore and more DevDuo apps.
Backup Reminder: The menu shows when you last backed up and reminds you after 30 days.

title: ✨ Share Your Cards in Real 3D!
message: Version 2.4.0 lets your friends see your cards in full 3D, even without the app. Sharing is now easier with more choices, and cards with many pages are simpler to use everywhere.
points: Share in 3D: Send one file that opens in any browser. Your friend can rotate, flip and tilt your card in 3D, no app needed.
Zoom & Full Screen: Pinch to zoom the 3D card, or tap Full Screen to show only the card.
More Ways to Share: Send your card as an Image, a PDF or a 3D file, all from one Share button.
Current or All Pages: For cards with many pages, choose to share just this page or all pages together.
White or Clear Background: Pick a white background or a transparent one when sharing as an image.
Cover Page: The page you view last in the Studio becomes the card's cover in your Gallery, Wallet and home screen widget.
Page Switcher: Move between pages with ‹ 1 / 3 › in the 3D view and in the Wallet.
Page Count Tags: See at a glance which cards have more than one page.
Perfect Exports: Saved images and PDFs now look exactly like the Sheet View, neatly centered.
Free Image Moving: Adjust arrows now move the image across the whole half page.
Bug Fixes: Smoother 3D flips, correct page shown in Flat Layout, and the right card shown when opening Reels and Cards view.

title: 👛 New 3D Wallet Mode is Here!
message: Your cards now live in a beautiful wallet! Version 2.3.0 brings a brand-new Wallet view, quick search, and an easier way to open the app straight to your cards.
points: 3D Wallet Mode: See all your cards neatly stacked, just like a real wallet.
Tap to Open: Your card glides to the center and shows in its real size.
Tap to Flip: Tap the open card to see the back side instantly.
Stack or List View: Switch between overlapping cards or one-below-another with one tap.
Quick Search: Type a name and the wallet jumps right to that card.
Start in Wallet: Tap the ⭐ to open the app directly in your Wallet.
DevDuo Apps Page: Discover more useful apps made by our team.
Cleaner Home Screen: Simple, same-size buttons for a neater look.

title: 🔄 Smooth 180° Flip & Motion Update
message: Flipping your cards is now smoother than ever! Version 2.2.0 introduces fluid 180° flip animations, tactile haptic response, and overall performance enhancements.
points: Instant 180° Flip: Tap the flip tool to smoothly spin directly between front and back without manual dragging.
Fluid Motion Physics: Replaced abrupt snap transitions with cinematic, natural rotation curves.
Tactile Haptic Feedback: Feel satisfying micro-vibrations when your card turns over.
Better Studio Handling: Auto-pauses continuous rotation cleanly when inspecting card details.
Performance Polishing: Smoother rendering and reduced memory usage inside the 3D Studio.

title: 📱 Home Screen Widgets & Quick Access Update
message: Access your essential cards faster than ever! Version 2.1.0 brings Home Screen Widgets, privacy-first vault shortcuts, and a refined premium experience.
points: Home Screen Widgets: Pin any card directly to your launcher for instant 1-tap access to your 3D viewer.
Smart Privacy Lock: Locked cards automatically stay hidden behind a secure biometric screen on your home screen.
Independent Card Widgets: Pin multiple cards simultaneously—each widget scales and manages its own security state.
Quick 1-Tap Restore: Easily restore prior purchases directly from the upgraded Premium screen with instant confirmation.
Performance Boost: Faster cold starts and seamless direct card loading when opening from widgets.

title: ⚡ Default 3D Mode & Multi-Layout Deck Update
message: Experience a major upgrade to your 3D Vault! Version 2.0.0 introduces custom launch preferences, new view layout modes, improved drawer navigation, and critical vault security fixes.
points: Default 3D Launch: Set the 3D Carousel as your primary launch screen directly from settings or top HUD.
New View Layouts: Seamlessly switch between Circular 3D, Vertical Reels, and Horizontal Cards modes.
Quick Select Disk 2.0: Upgraded drawer search and tag filtering for instantaneous file discovery.
Vault Security Fix: Resolved card detection bugs for locked secure files inside the 3D Carousel Deck.

title: 🌐 Ecosystem Hub Integration & Discovery Pass
message: We have fully deployed the custom DevDuo Apps portfolio deck, giving you seamless access to our growing ecosystem of utility dashboards, secure vaults, and creative 3D spaces.
points: DevDuo Ecosystem Page: Integrated a beautifully styled cross-promotional slider showcasing high-priority listings, upcoming software tracks, and platform direct routing links.
Optimized Core Header HUD: Upgraded background check handlers to sync case boundaries safely between string collections without introducing any runtime overhead.

title: 🚀 Interruption-Free Experience & Stability Pass
message: We have re-engineered our ad pipeline and interaction loops to prioritize your workflow—eliminating network blockages, dropping connectivity error overlays, and smoothing out baseline performance.
points: Pipeline Loop Refactoring: Optimized the background asset loading threads to cleanly dispose of failed instances without adding UI thread overhead.
Performance Optimization: Enhanced internal state processing to eliminate minor lag spikes and ensure lightning-fast UI responses across long creative cycles.

title: 🎬 Seamless Full-Screen Workspace Fixes
message: We've optimized full-screen immersive view presentation controls across the studio editor and carousel decks while securing stability updates.
points: Unified Full-Screen Experience: Tap anywhere on the card canvas spaces to hide UI panels instantly and enjoy clean, clutter-free 3D card presentation displays.
Network Error Dialogue Protection: Introduced a smart network warning to alert users transparently when ad blockers or lack of internet block verification checks.
Visual Material Reference Fix: Resolved an asset rendering tracking bug where look and material finish changes would display wrong page details on multi-page cards.
State Transformation Settle Guard: Stabilized alignment layouts by introducing clean workspace transform resets when pages are deleted inside the active builder.
Legacy Save Database Support: Fully optimized deserialization pipelines to guarantee existing user databases update to the new system cleanly with zero file corruption.

title: 🌀 Introducing the 3D Cinematic Deck Viewer
message: We've added an entirely new way to experience, browse, and search through your 3D Card Vault with high-end fluid animations.
points: Cinematic Carousel Deck: A brand new interactive view mode that places your 3D documents center stage.
Dual Gutter Edge Gestures: Drag up and down along the screen edges to rotate through your files smoothly.
High-Speed Reactive Search: Locate specific documents instantly directly within the main gallery layout.
Data Sync Optimization: Completely decoupled build states to optimize card rendering framerates and lookups.
Multi-Page Failure Guard: Secured file indexing structures to avoid view locks on empty page transitions.

title: ✨ Introducing the Update Hub
message: We've added a dedicated space to keep your 3D Vault perfectly in sync with our latest innovations.
points: New Update Hub: Access interactive changelogs and version history.
Smart Notifications: Stay informed about important security and feature patches.
UI Refinement: Moved update controls to the navigation dock for a cleaner workspace.
System Stability: Optimized remote configuration fetching for faster app launches.
